description: Street Closures - Road Closings is a dataset listed in Analyzejerseycity open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Engineering, Traffic & Transportation. This is a map of street closures and road closings in Jersey City. VIEW MAP. Coverage: Jersey City, New Jersey. The portal files it under Transportation. Its keywords are Infrastructure, 2018, 2019, Streets, Traffic, Road. The portal shows 2019-01-02 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-jerseycitynj-gov-portal.
